description: Agent-readiness audit of an MCP server (a Lighthouse for MCP): score 0-100 plus prioritised fixes for broken or untyped schemas, undocumented parameters, missing readOnlyHint/destructiveHint, tool names some clients reject, protocol version, uptime, breaking changes, and how many tokens its tool list costs an agent per session. Pass serverId for a listed server, or url to check any MCP endpoint live (one handshake + tools/list; no tool is ever called). Use it when building or choosing a server.

url.description: Any MCP endpoint URL to check live, e.g. 'https://example.com/mcp'.

name: audit_server
